files.src/monitor/__main__.py:
"""usage: python -m monitor <reference.csv> <current.csv>"""
import sys


def load(path):
    with open(path) as handle:
        return [[float(x) for x in line.split(",")] for line in handle if line.strip()]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    reference, current = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
    zero = sum(1 for row in current if not any(row))
    print(sys.argv[2], len(reference), len(current), "zero rows:", zero)
